lifecycle.title: Status
lifecycle.DraftDescription: A Draft is visible only to those who may edit it.
lifecycle.PublishedDescription: The Event is published to its audience.
lifecycle.CancelledDescription: The Event is cancelled. It stays visible, struck through, with everything recorded for it.
lifecycle.publishExplanation: Its audience will see it. A published Event can be cancelled later, but never returns to Draft.
lifecycle.cancelExplanation: The Event stays visible to its audience, struck through. Its Responses, Registrations and Attendance are kept, and you can reinstate it later.
lifecycle.reinstateExplanation: The Event is published again, as it was before it was cancelled.
lifecycle.deleteExplanation: The Event is removed for good, with everything recorded for it. This cannot be undone.
lifecycle.deleteRemoves: This also removes {responses, plural, one {# Response} other {# Responses}}, {registrations, plural, one {# Registration} other {# Registrations}} and {attendance, plural, one {# Attendance record} other {# Attendance records}}.
